What happened during the Jamia Millia Islamia protest in Delhi? In this ground report, students share their accounts of the police action, alleged detention for three days for providing water to protesters, and the controversy surrounding the “FREE KASHMIR” slogan. We also asked students why Rahul Gandhi did not visit Jamia and what they think about his absence.
Watch this exclusive Jamia protest coverage for students’ reactions, police action allegations, and the latest developments from the ground.
